description:
Situated within a cul-de-sac in the popular NR1 area, this well presented semi detached house is offered for sale with no onward chain! The property is presented in good order throughout, whilst also offering scope for purchasers to add their own personal touch and make the home their own! 

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall, a smartly presented kitchen and a comfortable living room. Upstairs, there are three well proportioned bedrooms, all accessed from the landing, together with a family shower room.

Outside, the property benefits from a private driveway providing off road parking, with an additional area of garden that could readily be converted to create further parking if required. The home also boasts an impressive 16ft garage, offering excellent versatility for additional parking, storage or, subject to the necessary consents, the potential to convert into an additional reception room. To the rear, the garden is a good size and has been well maintained, featuring a generous lawned area complemented by mature shrubs, colourful planting and established flower beds.

Sienna Mews is ideally positioned within the popular NR1 area of Norwich, offering excellent access to a wide range of everyday amenities and the city centre. Local shops and supermarkets are conveniently close by, including Aldi and Tesco Express on Plumstead Road, while a variety of cafés, takeaways and other facilities can be found within easy reach. The area is well served by public transport, with Norwich Railway Station approximately 0.8 miles away, providing regular connections to a range of destinations. For leisure, Riverside and the city centre are both easily accessible, offering an excellent choice of shops, restaurants, bars and entertainment. Families are also well catered for, with a number of primary and secondary schools located nearby, making Sienna Mews a convenient and well connected location for a range of buyers!
